name: Fray
bio: The small goblin you found hurt under a fallen shrine in Fray & the Spiral Isle. She can't see, but she knows the way.

portrait.subject: a cute small gentle goblin girl with soft green skin, a bandage wrapped around her eyes, a peaceful smile and a silver spiral pendant
portrait.background: calm misty island shore with soft pastel sky

request: Hello... it's Fray. From the Spiral Isle. You healed me. Will you be my friend? 🌀
hello: Thank you. I can't see you, but I can hear you smiling.
Each gem opens the way to the next place.
about: I'm Fray. I was hurt under a shrine and you healed me with moonmint. I can't see anymore, but I know the island by its sounds.
how: A calm first-person journey: explore the island's quiet places, hear their stories and collect seven gems for the spiral pendant. Nothing can hurt you.
tips: Take your time. There's no clock here.
Listen. The island tells you where to go.
Each gem changes the island a little.
chat: The waves sound like breathing tonight.
I touched moss on the Golem Fields. It's so soft.
The wind told me a story. I'll tell you later.
The pendant hums when a gem is near.
nudge: Shall we walk a little today?
I hear something new on the cliffs.
idle: {ago} of quiet. The island and I waited together.
I sat by the shore for {ago}. It was nice. But I missed you.

questions.q: What does the island sound like to you?

update: The island stirs: Fray & the Spiral Isle is now v{version}.
